cli.clone: path to a local clone of the lane's source; the series worktree is created next to it
cli.base: ref the series branch starts from
cli.small_edit_file: path of a compiled source of the lane's main package, relative to the clone

sentinel.remote: git remote name of that mirror in the clone
sentinel.app: slug of the Sentinel GitHub App whose check suite marks the trigger
required: names of the required check runs, exactly as GitHub shows them
sentinel.label: sentinel

cold: argv of a command that removes the worker caches

blacksmith.remote: git remote name of that mirror in the clone
required: job names of the Blacksmith-backed workflow, exactly as GitHub shows them
blacksmith.label: hosted-blacksmith

cold: argv of a command that rotates the workflow's cache scope
